record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare HIGH_JUMP_KICK: Buneary (1 star) and Lopunny (2 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are star count and stats (both maxPP 80, range 1). Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target. Unless the target holds a Twist Band, the caster takes up to 40 PP from the target (ppStolen = min(40, target.pp), read before the exchange): the caster is asked to gain ppStolen and the target to lose ppStolen, and the target's manaBurnCount is incremented (even when ppStolen is 0). Then, regardless of Twist Band, SPECIAL damage is dealt to the target (raw 15 at 1 star, 30 at 2 stars; 60 / 120 for 3 / 4 stars are in the table but not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts). The PP exchange is two independent addPP requests: each can be blocked or altered by addPP's own guards, so the amount actually gained and the amount actually lost can differ from ppStolen and from each other.

targeting.note: No area, no secondary targets. The target is chosen by the generic cast pipeline (not traced here).

geometry.shape: single target; no displacement despite the name

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT); other multipliers inside handleSpecialDamage were not enumerated here. The damage is not conditioned on the PP exchange: it is dealt also to a Twist Band holder.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies its attacker/field multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. This ability does not use the returned takenDamage or death.

effects.target: the cast target loses PP, the caster gains PP

declaredRaw.label: requested PP amount (raw)

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit: both addPP calls pass apBoost 0 and crit false, so the AP / crit factors in addPP are 1.
effects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Caster gain: addPP(+ppStolen): value = round(ppStolen x (fatigue ? 0.5 : 1)); applyTwistBandBuff leaves a positive value unchanged; the gain is dropped if the caster is silenced, has protect, has the NO_PP_GAIN effect or is resurrecting; otherwise pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1). The caster's pp was already reduced by maxPP in AbilityStrategy.process before the gain. Target loss: addPP(-ppStolen): value = -ppStolen (the Twist Band flip cannot apply because Twist Band holders skip the block); the loss is dropped if the target has status.tree or is resurrecting; otherwise pp = clamp(pp - ppStolen, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1). No Big Eater Belt hook exists in addPP, so Big Eater Belt does not change either amount. The caster's gain is not reduced when the target's loss is blocked, and vice versa. The target holding Twist Band is checked only on the target: a Twist Band on the caster does not matter because the caster's amount is positive.

incremented once per cast inside the non-Twist-Band block, independent of ppStolen (also when target.pp is 0) and independent of whether either addPP changed any PP. What the counter is used for elsewhere was not traced.

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; 3 and 4 stars (60, 120, also the ?? fallback 120) are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the listed units. The PP cap 40 and the Twist Band rule do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in this strategy; range comes from the unit (1).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP (80) of PP in the base process; the target's PP is drained again on later casts (up to 40 per cast).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 15 / 30 (1 / 2 stars) and a PP exchange of min(40, target.pp). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit multiplier, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied PP: caster gain = round(ppStolen x fatigue factor) subject to silence / protect / NO_PP_GAIN / resurrecting and clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1; target loss = ppStolen subject to status.tree / resurrecting and the same clamp; the two are independent. A Twist Band target loses and gives nothing but still takes the damage.
